exact_sql.name: active_workspace_count_exact_opsbackup
exact_sql.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM domain_objects WHERE project='' AND kind=? AND json_extract(body,'$.status')=?

exact_sql.name: workspace_status_counts
exact_sql.sql: SELECT json_extract(body,'$.status') AS status,count(*) AS count FROM domain_objects WHERE project='' AND kind='WorkspaceBinding' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 16

exact_sql.name: active_workspace_public_fields
exact_sql.sql: SELECT id,revision,json_extract(body,'$.authorized_workspace_ref') AS authorized_workspace_ref,json_extract(body,'$.project_id') AS project_id,json_extract(body,'$.real_path') AS real_path,json_extract(body,'$.access') AS access,json_extract(body,'$.status') AS status,json_extract(body,'$.host_principal_ref') AS host_principal_ref FROM domain_objects WHERE project='' AND kind='WorkspaceBinding' AND json_extract(body,'$.status')='ACTIVE' ORDER BY id LIMIT 9

exact_sql.name: historical_subject_project_current_metadata
exact_sql.sql: SELECT project,kind,id,revision,json_extract(body,'$.status') AS status,json_extract(body,'$.real_path') AS real_path FROM domain_objects WHERE kind='Project' AND id=? LIMIT 2

exact_sql.name: queue_state_counts
exact_sql.sql: SELECT state,count(*) AS count FROM client_command_queue GROUP BY state ORDER BY state LIMIT 32

exact_sql.name: control_state_counts
exact_sql.sql: SELECT state,count(*) AS count FROM client_control_requests GROUP BY state ORDER BY state LIMIT 32

exact_sql.name: table_counts
exact_sql.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total_tables,sum(CASE WHEN name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_sqlite_tables FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='table'

exact_sql.name: restoration_barrier_count
exact_sql.sql: SELECT count(*) AS barriers FROM backup_restore_barriers

exact_sql.name: restoration_trigger_presence
exact_sql.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='trigger' AND name='backup_require_fresh_observation'

intent: Exact production active workspace selector plus selected public binding/project fields and queue/control aggregate counts.
